about: If you have never seen the 1987 series and want the twelve episodes that explain the 2026 one, this is our list. It is a recommendation, not canon — nobody at Netflix asked for it. Each entry names the 2026 episode it explains.
disclaimer: Our opinion. Watch in any order.

episodes.title: Reconcilable Differences
episodes.why: The premiere, and the pilot the revival retitles. Denise Huxtable arrives at Gilbert Hall, meets Jaleesa and Whitley, and the dorm's whole social physics is established in half an hour.

episodes.title: Those Who Can't...Tutor
episodes.why: The episode the 2026 title 'Those Who Can...Cuff' edits. Also the template for Dwayne as the person who quietly takes the hit for someone else.

episodes.title: Sometimes You Get the Bear...Sometimes the Bear Gets You
episodes.why: Homecoming, a mascot-head prank, and Denise's grandfather — the episode whose title the 2026 season's eighth-hour episode rewrites for culture instead of a bear.

episodes.title: Romancing Mr. Stone
episodes.why: The professor-crush episode: what the original did with projection and wanting. Half of the 2026 romance plot is descended from this.

episodes.title: Gift of the Magi
episodes.why: Whitley's parents' marriage breaks up over a holiday; the family you inherit arrives as damage. The 2026 finale reaches back to this title for a reason.

episodes.title: Mr. Hillman
episodes.why: Whitley enters the Miss Hillman pageant to please her mother and Denise attacks the pageant's elitism by entering Dwayne. Hazel's Miss Gilbert Hall run in 2026 is this episode, restaged.

episodes.title: Dr. War Is Hell
episodes.why: The reset: Col. Taylor arrives as 'Dr. War', Kim moves in as Whitley's roommate, Freddie arrives with a crush on Dwayne. Four of the revival's returning adults start here.

episodes.title: A Stepping Stone
episodes.why: Homecoming and stepping: Whitley choreographs Gilbert Hall's routine and Jaleesa throws her off the squad. The ritual the 2026 homecoming episode lives inside.

episodes.title: Radio Free Hillman
episodes.why: The dean kills Dwayne's radio show; the students occupy the administration building; nobody is simply right. The 2026 student-voice and organising episodes both come from here.

episodes.title: A World Alike
episodes.why: Anti-apartheid organising against a scholarship funded by a company with South African investments — principle versus one Black student's funding, with no clean exit. The single most useful episode for reading the 2026 season's politics.

episodes.title: If I Should Die Before I Wake
episodes.why: A student discloses she is HIV-positive and the room has to reconsider everything. The most important half-hour this franchise ever made, and the reason the 2026 show's 'serious crisis' slot carries weight.

episodes.title: In the Eye of the Storm
episodes.why: A hurricane strands Freddie and Ron at the radio station mid-argument, and they have to talk. The device the 2026 tornado episode uses.
